title: parallel tempering + contrastive coherence (smooth LM)
hypothesis: a better scorer + tempering escapes the 71.98 basin to per-colour-coherent English at K=4
insights: K=4 Prior-A tempered search with the SMOOTH LM objective: best global free-hexagram -20.15/char, LM global -5.61, per-colour hexagrams [-24.41, -23.9, -24.01, -24.41].

Per-colour partitions remain GIBBERISH (each ~-24.2/char vs English -13). This matches exp 055's prediction: a 4-alphabet per-position cipher cannot make all four colour partitions English, so the cross-colour 'words' the 71.98 basin shows are an artifact, not a decryption.

Even with a non-saturating scorer and parallel tempering + contrastive per-colour coherence, the K=4 per-position model stays at the cross-colour-fragment wall. Combined with exp 055 (min fanout 7), this is strong evidence K4 is NOT a 4-alphabet per-position substitution -- the dominant repo hypothesis should be downweighted.
next_steps: abandon K=4 per-position as the primary model (055+056 agree); pursue transposition+substitution composites and the fanout<=k plaintext-generation filter (055)
